description: Payload visiting variants: a root with no encrypted field (zero visits), a nested single-object relation create (non-array) reached through pinnedPost, an update whose data wraps a nested relation create array, a Post root whose author relation create switches the active model to User, a Category root with no encrypted target, and a posts create array where only some items carry the encrypted content field.

        name         String? /// @encrypted
        posts        Post[]
        pinnedPost   Post?   @relation(fields: [pinnedPostId], references: [id], name: "pinnedPost")
